notes.name: Slallen Creek of Luck
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Rral'eness — silver mining town
notes.legend: Rral'eness is a mining town of 307 people just nearby the silver mine.

notes.name: The Pink Panther
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious pan-fried panther with bright liquor is served here.

notes.name: The Red Rat
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious spit-roasted bacon with light gin is served here.

notes.name: The Lucky Hound
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious dressed hound with pink sap is served here.

notes.name: Rearesdonese Lighthouse
notes.legend: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.

notes.name: Dungeon
notes.legend: Undiscovered dungeon. See One page dungeon

notes.name: Balboney Monster
notes.legend: Old sailors tell stories of a gigantic sea monster inhabiting these dangerous waters. Rumors say it can be 25 ft long.

notes.name: Rhes'tex Forest
notes.legend: A forest sacred to local Arago (Arachnid) Druids.

notes.name: Ialx Rats
notes.legend: A gang of forest brigands.

notes.name: Pirates
notes.legend: Pirate ships have been spotted in these waters.

notes.name: Veekzi Stele
notes.legend:
An ancient stele. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
ዘበዐበሀጰሐሠሰ ፐገ ሀጸዘፈጠዐበገፈዘዐተጰዐጸሠ ሀዘቀበፀዘጠሀወጸሀከየዘሰ

notes.name: Ruined Town
notes.legend: Ruins of an ancient town. Untold riches may lie within.

notes.name: Herras Library
notes.legend: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

notes.name: Travelling Unmissable Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this unmissable circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Allintacha Fair
notes.legend: A fair is being held in Allintacha, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

notes.name: Mooses migration
notes.legend: A huge group of mooses are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

notes.name: Ancient Rift
notes.legend: A rumoured ancient rift in this area is causing nearby plants to wither and decay.

notes.name: Disturbed Burial
notes.legend: A burial site has been disturbed in this area, causing the dead to rise and attack the living.

notes.name: Knutsterton Tomb
notes.legend: A sprawling necropolis built within a labyrinthine network of catacombs. Its halls are lined with countless alcoves, each housing the remains of the departed, while the distant sound of rattling bones fills the air.

notes.name: Random encounter
notes.legend: You have encountered a character.
